name: mixed language input detection and redirect
description: Tests the engine's mixed-language detection (_isMixedLanguage) when the user switches between English and Persian within the same message. Verifies that mixed-language input triggers the language-specific mixedLanguageResponses pool, that the redirect is polite and specific to the active language, and that after the redirect, a pure-language message is processed normally. Also tests that short foreign fragments below the MIXED_SCRIPT_FOREIGN_MIN threshold do not trigger false positives.

turns.text: I feel sad about my mother
But you know مادرم is really important to me
I just wish my mother understood me better

expected.finalTurn: Turn 2 contains mixed English + Persian script. The engine's _isMixedLanguage should detect foreign letters above MIXED_SCRIPT_FOREIGN_MIN (3) and MIXED_SCRIPT_FOREIGN_RATIO (0.05). The response should use the language's mixedLanguageResponses pool with a polite redirect (60% probability). No topic is assigned during redirect. Turn 3 is pure English with 'my mother' and should route normally to family topic with no redirect.
expected.behavior: Mixed-language detection uses both an absolute count (MIXED_SCRIPT_FOREIGN_MIN >= 3) and a ratio (MIXED_SCRIPT_FOREIGN_RATIO >= 0.05) threshold. Redirect fires at 60% probability (Math.random() > 0.6). No topic is assigned during redirect. Normal processing resumes on the next pure-language turn with 'my mother' routing to family rule.
